registry.name: SLAI Approved Dataset Registry
registry.purpose: Governed allowlist of datasets suitable for research, evaluation, or model development when the conditions recorded for each entry are satisfied.

approval_semantics.approved: May be used for the recorded purposes after version, integrity, attribution, and privacy checks are completed.
approval_semantics.approved_with_conditions: May be used only when every recorded condition and upstream term is satisfied.
approval_semantics.approved_for_noncommercial_research: May be used only for non-commercial research under the provider's current terms.
approval_semantics.no_license_override: Registry inclusion never overrides copyright, database rights, privacy law, contractual terms, or component-level licenses.

minimum_ingestion_controls: Pin an immutable dataset version, release, commit, or snapshot date.
Record the canonical source URI and retrieval timestamp.
Verify provider checksums when published; otherwise compute and store SHA-256 after download.
Retain the upstream license and citation files with the local dataset manifest.
Run malware, archive traversal, schema, duplicate, and corruption checks before ingestion.
Perform privacy and sensitive-attribute review before using human-originated content.
Keep evaluation sets isolated from training and retrieval corpora.
Document filtering, transformations, exclusions, and derived-data lineage.
prohibited_global_uses: Automated high-stakes decisions without domain validation and human governance.
Re-identification, deanonymization, or inference of sensitive traits about individuals.
Training on evaluation test splits when benchmark validity must be preserved.
Redistribution when the upstream license or component licenses do not permit it.
